name: Sarai Bazaar
description: Market town on the highway: a covered bazaar street, the carpet market, a truck stop and fuel station (A), the two-storey Sarai Hotel (B) and the district centre.

briefing.attack: Push off the burnt-out highway through the bazaar gate, the carpet market or the side alleys.
briefing.defend: Hold the district centre behind its HESCO walls; the roundabout links both sites.
briefing.A: The truck stop: fuel pumps under a canopy, a mechanic's workshop, a parked tanker and jingle truck.
briefing.B: The Sarai Hotel courtyard and ground floor; outside stairs climb to a balcony over the courtyard.

duel._comment: 1v1 duels: site A only (the truck stop); a player-clip wall along x = 6.5 closes the east half (residential, hotel).
